name: Junkie-7B-DUS (Depth-Upscaled 36L 16-Expert Sparse MoE from Junkie-3B on Triune Architecture)
description: Junkie-7B-DUS depth-upscales a trained Junkie-3B (16L, 1024D, 16E+1S) checkpoint to 36 layers (~7.02B total / 16E + 1 Shared Expert) via best-layer looping (scripts/expand_depth.py) followed by WSD healing.
